criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Inspect every frozen diagnostic and turntable frame against references; silhouette, construction, proportions and materials must meet the brief. Required: Flattened fossil frond impression in thin irregular full-volume rock slab, never a living fern; Tapering outline with closely packed alternating primary branch units and nested subordinate branch relief along zigzag axial boundary; Gentle axial deflection, no invented stalk, leaflets, roots, eyes or reconstructed living underside. Scope: Original simplified Charnia masoni fossil-form study informed by Dunn et al2019 Fig1F, explicitly identified BGS GSM105873 latex mould. Not exact specimen facsimile or scan. Genus-level scientific affinity uncertain; institutional Animalia catalog grouping is not settled phylogeny. Illustrative fossil length0.21m and slab0.12x0.26x0.012m, not measured dimensions of BGS specimen. Actual fossil relief and preservation do not establish living tissue thickness, color, posture or unseen rear face. Slab underside is artistic rock, not organism underside. Holotype conflict resolved for this asset by NOT selecting holotype: paper LEIUG2328 and GB3D SM A48259 catalog identities are not equated and neither is the modeled specific reference.

Tapering outline with closely packed alternating primary branch units and nested subordinate branch relief along zigzag axial boundary
Gentle axial deflection, no invented stalk, leaflets, roots, eyes or reconstructed living underside
concept_decisions: Concept has attractive slab relief but too many thin fern-like leaflets, invented central stalk, reconstructed basal disk and hand. Remove hand/stalk/disk; use broad tightly packed sigmoidal alternating units, nested shorter secondary furled ridges inside units, shallow negative integral relief. Axial slight bend indicates preservation only, not movement. Fossil no photographic grain. Slab thin with irregular corners; source Fig1F latex mould tonal polarity is not copied as exact fossil morphology. No equivalence between GB3D SM A48259 and paper LEIUG2328 asserted; BGS GSM105873 caption unambiguous.
